chapter: Inside the Basie rhythm section and band family
title: Greene as the peacemaker
summary: He says he was always the peacemaker among the men who went out together.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Well, it -- yeah, it is. It's very good. I don't understand, though, what Basie's secret is in, sort of, really keeping a band in pretty good order. I mean, we know -- we're not talking now of the recent years --
Yeah. I know -- yeah, I know. Even today --
I mean, you're talking now of a period when it was full of individuals. It was -- I mean, you know --
We got along, together, you know. As a family, as brothers. Really.
I mean, we did, Stan. We, you know -- whatever -- you know -- I was always the peacemaker.

Oh (laugh). You know, I was always -- 'now, wait a minute -- don't do that, don't do this'. (laugh) You know what I mean. And, so that's -- we really got along. You know, we never let things get out of hand no kind of way, you know.
But, I mean, when you say you were the peacemaker -- between Basie and the men, or between the individual guys, what?
Between the guys that -- all used to go out together and have fun, you know. You know, that's what I mean.
Yes, you know. I'd see them doing something wrong -- 'Wait a minute', you know.
Or if somebody got too high.
Yeah, you know. To take them --
